Computers and Structures

SAP2000

SAP2000 supports general structural analysis and design for buildings and infrastructure.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Define a structural system

Begin with the idealised geometry, material assumptions and analysis scope. In the intended SAP2000 preview, define a structural system; the visible result is a solver-ready model view with mesh regions and constraints exposed. Review units, connectivity, mesh suitability and model assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Run load combinations

Use the selected load cases, contacts and solution controls. In the intended SAP2000 preview, run load combinations; the visible result is a configured analysis state with loads and boundary conditions visible. Review load paths, restraints, convergence controls and applicable codes before accepting or exporting it.

Review member demand and design

Start from the completed result set and acceptance quantities. In the intended SAP2000 preview, review member demand and design; the visible result is plots or tables that connect response values to the model. Review convergence, sensitivity, units and engineering reasonableness before accepting or exporting it.
